description:
The Swachh Bharat Mission Gramin Phase II is a government initiative aimed at improving sanitation and hygiene in rural areas of India. 

The objective of the scheme is to eliminate open defecation and promote sustainable sanitation practices. 

The benefits include the construction of individual household toilets and community toilets. 

Assistance is provided to rural households for the construction of toilets. 

Eligibility is primarily for households in rural areas that do not have access to sanitation facilities. 

The application process typically involves submitting a request to the local gram panchayat or relevant authority. 

The scheme is implemented in a phased manner with a focus on achieving complete sanitation coverage. 

The implementing authorities include the Ministry of Jal Shakti and the respective state governments. 

The mission aims to create a clean and healthy environment for rural communities.
